verdict.rationale: Dropbox's own developer docs say apps can receive change notifications via webhooks, and a dedicated Webhooks API reference page exists, so documented outbound callbacks on content change are evidenced. The pack contains nothing on how callbacks are verified or how failed deliveries are retried, which are explicit parts of the story. Missing for 10: documented webhook verification (challenge/signature) semantics, documented retry/delivery semantics, payload details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file events push to me — documented webhooks/change notifications fire when content changes, with verification and retry semantics spelled out

citations.quote: receive notifications for any changes in Dropbox using webhooks
